purpose: Compare the two retained layer-16 finals under identical constrained-choice and workspace-necessity interventions before any natural generation is inspected.

estimands.primary: counterfactual-twin prediction flips toward the matched donor answer relative to intact
secondary: intact exact choice accuracy and margin
full-route versus hard-bypass and fixed/random carriers
within-world twin versus cross-world shuffle specificity
affected directionality and unaffected prediction stability reconstructed without post-hoc subsets
estimands.cell_comparison: semantic minus task for each predeclared metric

stop_rule: Run task then semantic once with the exact mode order. Preserve any failure and do not rerun, tune an intervention, or select a query subset after observing results.
claim_boundary: These retained-fixture evaluations can separate carrier dependence, content replacement, and donor directionality only within the constrained-choice task. They do not establish natural chat quality, broad generalization, or semantic causality when exact donor-directed effects are absent.
